title: Norway's EVs Buried Gas Cars On The Road
source: Norwegian Road Federation (OFV) new-car registration data. Battery-electric vehicles' share of new car sales in Norway climbed from single digits in the early 2010s past gasoline-and-diesel models around 2019, and now accounts for the vast majority of new cars sold there. Figures approximate as publicly reported, rounded to the nearest percentage point; hybrids omitted so the two shown shares don't sum to 100.
